text: Since both PT and aPTT are normal, this suggests a defect in primary hemostasis, likely platelet function or von Willebrand factor, rather than a coagulation factor deficiency. I need to assess primary hemostasis directly; REQUEST TEST: Bleeding_Time

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal vWF results combined with mucosal bleeding and a family history consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance suggest Glanzmann thrombasthenia, a platelet function defect. DIAGNOSIS READY: Glanzmann thrombasthenia
